_comment: The application commit this workflow is approved to deploy.
A 40-hex app_sha input establishes SYNTAX, not approval. Every commit on
every branch is 40 hex characters. This file is the approval, it lives on
the default branch, and changing it is a reviewed change.
The candidate checkout never supplies its own approval: this file is read
from the operational checkout (the commit the workflow itself ran from),
never from the application commit under deployment.
Future acceptances are a one-line edit here, reviewed like any other.
packageLabel: Candidate D plus the onboarding repair. Candidate D (a3496eb) is the member experience: a compact staging strip; a shared option row for every guided decision; global Open Graph and Twitter share metadata with a branded 1200x630 image; a mobile acceptance suite over three phone contexts; signed-in Home leading with your communities and each card's next action; Start your community and goal creation as guided decisions with truthful joining copy and the browser's own date-and-time control; Join explaining what joining means; Community Home leading with the goal, with invitation, link rotation and leaving behind an Invite card and Manage. On top of that, 46eb91a binds share metadata to the deployed channel origin (the Auth domain is not the channel, so og:image and canonical were pointing at a 404) and stops printing the invite link anywhere; 77bda41 repairs onboarding: the identity line now names the account so two accounts sharing a display name can be told apart, and the verify screen states what actually happened to the verification send instead of always claiming a link was sent. Admission copy states only what the code enforces. On top of candidate B (65d258d) and candidate C (fcb83f7).
_expectedPriorFunctionsNote: The WSF inventory staging is expected to carry BEFORE this deployment: 24 functions = the 23-function state Package E left (22 pre-Package-E functions plus wsfSetGoalDisplayAuthorization) PLUS wsfGoalRecentAdditions, which staging run 3 (35362036618, 2026-09-18) created before its invoker-policy failure aborted that deploy (its invoker policy was never set). Run 4 (35368478133) correctly refused to deploy against the stale 23 baseline. Evidence for the 24: run 3's deploy log shows exactly the 23 reviewed functions updated and exactly one created; verify-deployment.mjs still requires the post-deploy inventory to equal its 24 expected names (anything else fails as 'present but not expected'), expects wsfGoalRecentAdditions as a created service, and reports its transport. This candidate (77bda41) changes only apps/westayfit app files, browser specs, scripts/westayfit and docs: `git diff 65d258d 77bda41 -- functions-westayfit firestore.rules firestore.indexes.json` is empty, so the prior count stays 24 and the post-deploy inventory must still equal the same 24 names; wsfGoalPulse keeps its nine-field contract. Reviewed per candidate; the next package will have a different prior count.
